name: indonesia-tenders-scraper
title: Indonesia Government Tenders Scraper (SPSE Nasional / LKPP)
description: Scrapes Indonesia's official national tender search (SPSE Nasional, run by LKPP) for public government procurement records across all ~600+ regional/agency LPSE portals -- browse recent tenders by year and keyword, or fetch full announcement detail for any tender code. No account or login needed.
